tasks.title: Create Credential Entry Modal Component
tasks.description: Build React modal for entering connector credentials (API keys, OAuth tokens). Dynamic form based on connector type. Test connection button. Mask credentials after save.

tasks.title: Implement Credential Validation API
tasks.description: Add endpoint to validate credentials against vendor APIs before saving. Test connection with SecurityScorecard, BitSight, RiskRecon APIs.

tasks.title: Update Connector Card Status States
tasks.description: Enhance ConnectorCard component to show all connection states: Not Connected, Connecting, Connected, Failed, Syncing, Sync Failed. Add last sync timestamp.

tasks.title: Implement SecurityScorecard Connector
tasks.description: Replace mock data with real API calls. Fetch overall score, network security, patching cadence, endpoint protection, hacker chatter, leaked credentials. Normalize to signal schema.

tasks.title: Set Up BullMQ Job Queue
tasks.description: Install and configure BullMQ with Redis. Create job queue for vendor sync operations. Implement job types: sync_vendor, sync_connector, assessment.

tasks.title: Implement Background Sync Worker
tasks.description: Create separate worker process for async vendor sync. Implement retry logic with exponential backoff (1min, 5min, 30min, 2hrs, 6hrs). Track sync job status in database.

tasks.title: Wire Vendor Sync to Scheduler
tasks.description: Integrate vendor sync into existing scheduler.js. Add sync frequencies based on vendor tier (Critical: daily, High: weekly, Medium/Low: monthly). Queue jobs instead of inline execution.

tasks.title: Implement BitSight Connector
tasks.description: Replace mock data with real BitSight API. Normalize BitSight score (250-900) to severity. Fetch grade, compromise history, vulnerability findings.

tasks.title: Implement RiskRecon Connector
tasks.description: Replace mock data with real RiskRecon API. Normalize RiskRecon grade (A+-F) to severity. Fetch attack surface findings, exposure severity.

tasks.title: Build Alert Service
tasks.description: Implement AlertService.js for notifications. Configure SendGrid for email alerts. Set up Slack webhooks. Create alert rules: Critical signal (immediate), Risk score +20 (1hr), Sync failure (daily digest).

tasks.title: Create Vendor Portfolio Dashboard
tasks.description: Build executive dashboard showing all vendors with risk scores. Sortable columns, search, filter by tier. Show top 10 high-risk vendors. Connector health summary.

tasks.title: Build Risk Trend Charts
tasks.description: Add Chart.js or Recharts integration. Display risk score trends over 12 months. Compare multiple vendors. Annotate significant events.

tasks.title: Create Sync Status API
tasks.description: Add endpoints to track sync job progress. GET /api/vendors/:vendorId/sync-status/:jobId. Return status, progress, error_message.

tasks.title: Add Vendor Sync Routes
tasks.description: Implement POST /api/vendors/:vendorId/sync endpoint. Queue background job. Return job_id for tracking.

tasks.title: Implement OAuth Flow for SecurityScorecard
tasks.description: Add OAuth authentication option for SecurityScorecard (if supported). Handle OAuth callback, token storage, token refresh.

tasks.title: Create Signal Correlation Logic
tasks.description: Implement signal correlation across multiple providers. Handle conflicting data (one High, one Low). Identify consistent high-risk findings.

tasks.title: Add Sync Frequency Selector
tasks.description: Add dropdown in credential modal for sync frequency. Options: Real-time (webhook), Hourly, Daily, Weekly. Default based on vendor tier.

tasks.title: Create Alert Notification Center
tasks.description: Build UI component for viewing alerts. Alert list with severity filters. Acknowledge alerts. Alert history.

tasks.title: Implement PDF Report Export
tasks.description: Add 'Download Report' button to executive dashboard. Generate PDF with vendor portfolio, risk trends, top risks. Use PDFKit or similar.

tasks.title: Make Dashboards Mobile Responsive
tasks.description: Optimize executive dashboard and vendor portfolio for mobile devices. Responsive layout, touch interactions, mobile-specific features.

tasks.title: Create Vendor Sync Jobs Table
tasks.description: Add database table for tracking sync jobs. Fields: id, organization_id, vendor_id, connector_type, status, started_at, completed_at, error_message, retry_count.

tasks.title: Create Vendor Alerts Table
tasks.description: Add database table for alert history. Fields: id, organization_id, vendor_id, alert_type, severity, message, sent_at. Unique constraint on (org, vendor, type, sent_at).

tasks.title: Add Credential Access Logging
tasks.description: Log credential view/modify operations. Store in audit_logs table. Track who, what, when. Add RBAC - only admins can view credentials.

tasks.title: Implement Credential Rotation Alerts
tasks.description: Alert on credentials older than 90 days. Support versioned credentials (v1, v2, v3). Rotation workflow UI.

tasks.title: Write Integration Tests
tasks.description: End-to-end tests for vendor monitoring flow. Test credential entry, connection, sync, alerting. Use Playwright or Cypress.

sprints.name: Credential Infrastructure
sprints.goal: Users can securely configure vendor monitoring credentials

sprints.name: SecurityScorecard Integration
sprints.goal: Real security posture data from SecurityScorecard

sprints.name: Multi-Source Integration
sprints.goal: Multiple data sources for comprehensive risk view
